name: AI Automation
summary: Agents and automations that do real work, not demos.
body:
One service covering the whole range: finding where AI genuinely helps, building it, and running it in production.

That means autonomous and human-in-the-loop agents that handle real operations such as research, outreach and support, wired into the systems you already run. It means automations that qualify leads, generate content on brand, and keep data in sync between your tools without anyone copying and pasting. And it means adding intelligence to an existing CRM, helpdesk or internal tool rather than replacing it.

Every build starts with a process audit, because most of what looks like an AI problem is a workflow problem. What survives that audit gets the right model, real guardrails, an evaluation set, and cost and failure monitoring, so you can tell whether it is working after launch rather than hoping.
